Aligning artists with world-class music direction, playback,
and mix engineering.

Shows are about people. 

Because it’s people who love music. 

It’s people who line up to hear their favorite artist’s tracks performed live, who sing every last lyric at the show.

And of all people, your engineer is the one person entrusted to deliver those tracks, and that vocal.

Music is more than tech. It’s trust. 

We’re people who care a lot about delivering that music as best as possible, every night.

Sound like we’re aligned?

About

We are comprised of a worldwide network of talented individuals with years of experience creating incredible musical moments.

Syncronicity is led by AJ Ramirez, whose work spans icons like Ariana Grande, Anderson .Paak, Victoria Monét, Tyla, The Kid Laroi, Yeah Yeah Yeahs, Melanie Martinez, Disney, Reggie Watts, Harry Styles, and more,

Together with an ever-growing network of musical professionals, Syncronicity aims to streamline everything for artists and productions, from crafting the ideal playback session + rig, to overseeing musical direction + audio operations for worldwide tours in the US, Europe, Asia, Australia, and beyond.
